ai_analysis.insight_en: Model quantization and efficient operator orchestration are critical to edge AI adoption, with Unsloth's throughput gains challenging the current economics of cloud-based inference. As the efficiency limits of small-parameter models expand, high-performance workstations are positioned to capture specific vertical workloads previously dependent on cloud infrastructure.

title: Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world'
title_en:
Frontier models can now propose technical social science research designs that experts grade more highly than the world's top political economist's---that's the finding from our new Free Systems eval, SnyderBench, in which we have PhD experts blind grade research proposals from AI models compared to papers written by Harvard political economist Jim Snyder (which the experts have not previously read). 

At the same time, we see no evidence that models can develop research ideas that experts rate as better overall contributions. They're getting better and better at the technical part of research, but not necessarily at the more subjective part.

This could be because human experts possess "judgment" that the models do not. 

It could also be that research "contribution" is so subjective that it doesn't actually point at any meaningful goal---consistent with this possibility, we find that our human experts don't agree with one another when rating project ideas for the strength of their contribution, with agreement rates barely higher than random chance. Perhaps social science research is what @alexolegimas might call a "relational good": something people value in part because it's produced by a human. We're not sure. 

This past January, I released the results of a pilot in which I had Claude Code replicate and extend a past empirical paper on vote-by-mail. 10 months later, it's stunning the amount of progress that's been made. It's no longer interesting to ask whether AI can collect data and run analyses automagically---we take that for granted---instead, the question is how much of the entire research loop AI can complete. Our tentative answer: AI can handle the technical aspects of empirical political economy research from end to end, devising the design and executing it, but for now, we still need humans to drive the agenda. 

This is joint work with @AndyCWMyers, and is of course dedicated to my PhD advisor Jim Snyder, who remains the world's great empirical political economist, AI or no AI. 

Lots more in the full piece here:

https://t.co/zgScGvp9EY

full_text_zh:
前沿模型现在可以提出比世界顶级政治经济学家的专家评分更高的技术社会科学研究设计——这是我们新的自由系统评估 SnyderBench 的发现，其中我们有博士专家对人工智能模型的研究提案与哈佛大学政治经济学家吉姆·斯奈德 (Jim Snyder) 撰写的论文（专家之前没有阅读过）进行了盲评。

与此同时，我们没有看到任何证据表明模型可以提出专家认为总体贡献更好的研究思路。他们在研究的技术部分越来越好，但在更主观的部分却不一定。

这可能是因为人类专家拥有模型所没有的“判断力”。

也可能是研究“贡献”是如此主观，以至于它实际上并没有指向任何有意义的目标——与这种可能性相一致，我们发现我们的人类专家在对项目想法的贡献强度进行评级时彼此不一致，一致率仅略高于随机机会。也许社会科学研究就是 @alexolegimas 所说的“关系善”：人们之所以重视它，部分原因是它是由人类产生的。我们不确定。

今年一月，我发布了一个试点结果，其中我让 Claude Code 复制并扩展了过去关于邮件投票的实证论文。 10 个月后，所取得的进展令人震惊。问人工智能是否可以自动收集数据并进行分析已经不再有趣了——我们认为这是理所当然的——相反，问题是人工智能可以完成整个研究循环的多少。我们的初步答案是：人工智能可以从头到尾处理实证政治经济学研究的技术方面，设计并执行它，但目前，我们仍然需要人类来推动议程。

这是与@AndyCWMyers 的联合工作，当然是献给我的博士生导师吉姆·斯奈德（Jim Snyder），无论人工智能与否，他仍然是世界上伟大的实证政治经济学家。

title_en:

title: The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more import
title_en:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes
full_text_en:
The next phase of the Motes ecosystem is getting closer, and community participation is about to become even more important.

@meetmotes is preparing to launch the Motes Aura Points Testnet, introducing a points system that connects user activity with future allocation opportunities.

The idea is to make participation count. As users interact with the ecosystem and engage with its AI Agent infrastructure, their activity can contribute to earning Aura Points.

These points are designed to play a role in allocation opportunities, giving users another reason to stay active and explore what Motes is building.

What’s interesting is how this connects to the bigger vision: Genesis NFTs introduce ownership and access to dedicated AI Agents, while Aura creates another layer that rewards verified participation.

It’s not just about holding an NFT anymore. Being involved in the ecosystem could matter too.

Genesis first. $MOTES next.

The Aura Points Testnet is coming soon. Stay ready!

@meetmotes
full_text_zh:
Motes 生态系统的下一阶段越来越近，社区参与也将变得更加重要。

@meetmotes 正准备启动 Motes Aura 积分测试网，引入一个将用户活动与未来分配机会联系起来的积分系统。

我们的想法是让参与变得有价值。当用户与生态系统互动并与其人工智能代理基础设施互动时，他们的活动可以有助于赚取 Aura 积分。

这些积分旨在在分配机会中发挥作用，为用户提供另一个保持活跃并探索 Motes 正在构建的内容的理由。

有趣的是这如何与更大的愿景联系起来：Genesis NFT 引入了专用人工智能代理的所有权和访问权限，而 Aura 创建了另一层来奖励经过验证的参与。

这不再只是持有 NFT 了。参与生态系统也很重要。

创世第一。接下来是$MOTES。

Aura Points 测试网即将推出。做好准备！

@meetmotes

title:
Things are insane right now:

1. jensen is back

2. google neon is low key elite

3. have fable build a 4K blender film
title_en:
Things are insane right now:

1. jensen is back

2. google neon is low key elite

3. have fable build a 4K blender film from one prompt and render it on rented GPUs for about $6

4. let your agent rent its own GPUs from inside the chat

5. point REA at any app you pay for and rebuild the feature you like

6. have claude code make 100+ on brand static ads and upload them to facebook through the API

7. make a UGC video ad for $4 that used to cost $500

8. scrape everyone who engaged with a linkedin post and drop them into a cold email sequence

9. run your whole GTM off one postgres database with three tables: accounts, people and signals

10. give grok bot a developer bot and a PM bot and let them ship pull requests all day

11. add a grok bot to your team's slack and video calls so it takes notes and follows up on deadlines

12. have an agent edit your videos in davinci resolve through its MCP

13. run every hard decision through gemini as a second opinion

14. turn every marketing job you do into a skill and give it to the whole team

15. and so much more its brain breaking

This is the greatest time to be building and it isn't even close.
title_zh:
现在的情况很疯狂：

1.詹森回来了

2. google neon 低调精英

3. 让《寓言》通过一个提示构建一部 4K 混合影片，并在租用的 GPU 上进行渲染，费用约为 6 美元

4. 让您的代理从聊天中租用自己的 GPU

5.
full_text_en:
Things are insane right now:

1. jensen is back

2. google neon is low key elite

3. have fable build a 4K blender film from one prompt and render it on rented GPUs for about $6

4. let your agent rent its own GPUs from inside the chat

5. point REA at any app you pay for and rebuild the feature you like

6. have claude code make 100+ on brand static ads and upload them to facebook through the API

7. make a UGC video ad for $4 that used to cost $500

8. scrape everyone who engaged with a linkedin post and drop them into a cold email sequence

9. run your whole GTM off one postgres database with three tables: accounts, people and signals

10. give grok bot a developer bot and a PM bot and let them ship pull requests all day

11. add a grok bot to your team's slack and video calls so it takes notes and follows up on deadlines

12. have an agent edit your videos in davinci resolve through its MCP

13. run every hard decision through gemini as a second opinion

14. turn every marketing job you do into a skill and give it to the whole team

15. and so much more its brain breaking

This is the greatest time to be building and it isn't even close.
full_text_zh:
现在的情况很疯狂：

1.詹森回来了

2. google neon 低调精英

3. 让《寓言》通过一个提示构建一部 4K 混合影片，并在租用的 GPU 上进行渲染，费用约为 6 美元

4. 让您的代理从聊天中租用自己的 GPU

5. 将 REA 指向您付费的任何应用程序并重建您喜欢的功能

6. 让 Claude Code 在品牌静态广告上制作 100+ 并通过 API 上传到 Facebook

7. 以 4 美元制作一个 UGC 视频广告，而以前的成本为 500 美元

8. 抓取所有参与过linkedin帖子的人并将他们放入冷电子邮件序列中

9. 在一个包含三个表的 postgres 数据库上运行整个 GTM：帐户、人员和信号

10. 给 grok 机器人一个开发者机器人和一个 PM 机器人，让他们全天发送 Pull 请求

11. 在团队的 Slack 和视频通话中添加一个 Grok 机器人，以便它记笔记并跟进截止日期

12.让代理通过其MCP在davinciresolve中编辑您的视频

13.通过双子座作为第二意见来做出每一个艰难的决定

14.将你所做的每一项营销工作变成一项技能，并将其传授给整个团队

15. 还有更多令人伤脑筋的事情

这是建设的最佳时机，而且还远未结束。

author: @RedHat_AI
summary_en: The vLLM inference framework released v0.34, introducing an extensible KV cache mechanism that leverages the GPU's virtual memory API for automated capacity management. This update deprecates manual tuning flags and adds support for 10 new models, effectively lowering deployment friction for large language models.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: vLLM开源推理框架发布v0.34版本，核心改进在于引入可扩展的KV缓存机制，利用GPU虚拟内存API实现缓存容量自动分配。该更新废弃了手动调节参数，支持包括Llama 3.2在内的10种新模型，显著降低了大模型在异构环境下的显存调优成本。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The vLLM inference framework released v0.34, introducing an extensible KV cache mechanism that leverages the GPU's virtual memory API for automated capacity management. This update deprecates manual tuning flags and adds support for 10 new models, effectively lowering deployment friction for large language models.

elements_zh.where: 模型推理部署领域
elements_zh.what: 发布v0.34版本，实现KV缓存容量的动态自动管理，不再强制配置gpu-memory-utilization参数
elements_zh.why: 旨在优化大模型推理场景下的显存利用效率与部署流程便捷性

elements_en.what: Released v0.34, enabling dynamic KV cache management via virtual memory API, removing the need for manual memory utilization configuration
elements_en.why: To optimize GPU memory efficiency and streamline deployment workflows for LLMs

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 显存动态管理是降低大模型私有化部署门槛的关键技术点，vLLM通过抽象底层硬件调度进一步巩固了其作为高性能推理引擎的市场标准地位。对于开发者而言，减少显存碎片化与参数手动配置，将使推理层的业务集成效率获得阶梯性提升。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Dynamic memory management is a critical bottleneck for private model deployment, and vLLM's abstraction of hardware-level scheduling reinforces its position as the industry-standard inference engine. For developers, automating memory allocation reduces fragmentation and deployment friction, significantly accelerating production-level integration.

This update deprecates manual tuning flags and adds support for 10 new models, effectively lowering deployment friction for large language models.
key_points_zh: 引入基于GPU虚拟内存API的可扩展KV缓存系统
废弃手动配置gpu-memory-utilization参数，优化资源分配
新增支持10种模型并完成超过1000次代码提交
key_points_en: Introduced extensible KV cache via GPU virtual memory API
Deprecated manual configuration of gpu-memory-utilization
Added support for 10 new models with 1,000+ commits
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 显存动态管理是降低大模型私有化部署门槛的关键技术点，vLLM通过抽象底层硬件调度进一步巩固了其作为高性能推理引擎的市场标准地位。对于开发者而言，减少显存碎片化与参数手动配置，将使推理层的业务集成效率获得阶梯性提升。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Dynamic memory management is a critical bottleneck for private model deployment, and vLLM's abstraction of hardware-level scheduling reinforces its position as the industry-standard inference engine. For developers, automating memory allocation reduces fragmentation and deployment friction, significantly accelerating production-level integration.

title: At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but imp
title_en:
At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but implementing them remains painfully slow.

I’ll explain. But since I’m new to posting on X, let me first introduce myself. 

I’m Barak,  a founder/investor with 2 exits and 3 IPOs. 
My cofounders and I started Bonobo AI, which was acquired in 2019 by Salesforce. There, we worked to help build the next generation of enterprise AI from the inside. 

I like to describe us as four Lego pieces: We fit together perfectly, complementing each other's strengths and building something stronger than the sum of its parts. That understanding allows us to move quickly, challenge one another without ego and operate as one team. 

It's also what brought us back together to build JUNE AI. 
Because while working at the heart of enterprise AI, we kept seeing the same problem: enterprise AI implementation is a massive undertaking.

The challenge is not simply choosing the right model. Enterprises want to move faster with AI, but the systems running their businesses are holding them back.

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘.
June turns the traditionally complex implementation of enterprise systems, AI agents, and data platforms into a plug-and-play moment, so businesses can grow and leverage AI without the wait.

June is built to work across the enterprise platforms your business relies on like (such as Salesforce, Databricks, Oracle, Workday, HubSpot, OpenAI, Anthropic, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft, and Snowflake)

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. Evolve safely: From discovery to production, every change is reviewed, sandbox-tested, and executed through native tools - fully auditable at every step.

2. Own the logic: June turns buried configuration into plain-language business rules, independent of any platform, so no vendor holds your logic.

3. Transform at any size: No downtime, no matter how complex the environment. June reads and understands your systems, whether legacy, custom-built, or brand new.

Thank you to @Benioff  and Time Ventures for leading our round, with @MichaelDell, @levie, @George_Kurtz, and Diane Greene participating.

We've done this once together. The problem this time is a lot bigger.

I'll be writing about my experiences as an investor and founder, and about what it takes to get AI out of the pilot and into production.

If that interests you, follow along for the journey.

full_text_zh:
在 June AI，我们筹集了 2000 万美元来解决人工智能中最大的问题：模型正在以惊人的速度前进，但实施它们仍然非常缓慢。

我会解释一下。但由于我是 X 上的新手，所以让我先自我介绍一下。

我是 Barak，一位创始人/投资者，拥有 2 次退出和 3 次 IPO。
我和我的联合创始人创立了 Bonobo AI，该公司于 2019 年被 Salesforce 收购。在那里，我们致力于从内部帮助构建下一代企业人工智能。

我喜欢将我们描述为四块乐高积木：我们完美地组合在一起，互补彼此的优势，并构建出比各部分总和更强大的东西。这种理解使我们能够快速行动，不以自我为中心互相挑战，并作为一个团队运作。

这也是我们重新聚在一起打造 JUNE AI 的原因。
因为在研究企业人工智能的核心时，我们不断看到同样的问题：企业人工智能的实施是一项艰巨的任务。

挑战不仅仅是选择正确的模型。企业希望利用人工智能更快地发展，但运行其业务的系统却阻碍了他们。

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘀𝘄𝗵𝘆𝘄𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘。
June 将传统上复杂的企业系统、人工智能代理和数据平台的实施转变为即插即用的时刻，因此企业可以无需等待即可发展和利用人工智能。

June 旨在跨您的业务所依赖的企业平台（例如 Salesforce、Databricks、Oracle、Workday、HubSpot、OpenAI、Anthropic、ServiceNow、SAP、Microsoft 和 Snowflake）工作

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. 安全发展：从发现到生产，每项更改都经过审查、沙箱测试并通过本机工具执行 - 每一步都完全可审核。

2. 拥有逻辑：June 将隐藏的配置转化为简单语言的业务规则，独立于任何平台，因此没有供应商掌握您的逻辑。

3. 任意规模转型：无论环境多么复杂，都无需停机。 June 会阅读并理解您的系统，无论是旧系统、定制系统还是全新系统。

感谢 @Benioff 和 Time Ventures 领导我们的这一轮融资，@MichaelDell、@levie、@George_Kurtz 和 Diane Greene 参与其中。

我们曾经一起做过一次这样的事。这次的问题就大了很多。

我将写下我作为投资者和创始人的经历，以及如何让人工智能脱离试点并投入生产。

如果您对此感兴趣，请跟随我们的旅程。

summary_en: Cloud infrastructure provider Nebius and NVIDIA will demonstrate the NVIDIA Agent Harness for Store Operations on December 3. The initiative aims to define execution boundaries and authorization limits for AI agents handling operational incidents like spills or checkout queues, ensuring autonomous compliance.
summary_zh: Nebius与英伟达将于12月3日展示NVIDIA Agent Harness零售门店运营蓝图，旨在规范化AI自动化处理应急流程。

quote_en: How can an AI agent respond to a spill or a checkout queue surge without acting outside its authority? Join Nebius and @NVIDIA on December 3 for a live demonstration of the NVIDIA Agent Harness Bluepr

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 云基础设施服务商Nebius联合英伟达将于12月3日演示NVIDIA Agent Harness在零售场景的自动化部署。该蓝图旨在定义AI代理在处理液体泄漏或收银排队激增等突发状况时的执行边界与权限控制，确保其在合规范围内实现业务响应。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Cloud infrastructure provider Nebius and NVIDIA will demonstrate the NVIDIA Agent Harness for Store Operations on December 3. The initiative aims to define execution boundaries and authorization limits for AI agents handling operational incidents like spills or checkout queues, ensuring autonomous compliance.

elements_zh.who: Nebius（云服务商）与英伟达（NVIDIA，计算平台提供商）
elements_zh.where: 线上实测演示（12月3日）
elements_zh.what: 展示NVIDIA Agent Harness零售运营蓝图，重点在于AI代理的权限约束与业务场景响应逻辑
elements_zh.why: 解决大模型驱动的自动化代理在零售复杂环境中的“越权执行”与操作规范化难题

elements_en.what: NVIDIA Agent Harness Store Operations Blueprint, focusing on agent guardrails and authorization logic.
elements_en.why: Addressing the challenge of preventing AI agents from exceeding authority in real-world retail environments.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: AI代理从实验室走向物理生产环境的核心瓶颈在于“权限边界控制”与“动作执行容错”。通过标准化蓝图将Agent执行逻辑架构化，标志着英伟达正在从单一硬件输出向行业级边缘智能的控制协议渗透，试图构筑物理世界的数字操作标准。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The bottleneck for AI agents moving into physical production environments lies in authorization boundaries and error handling. By formalizing these logic gates, NVIDIA is shifting from a hardware-centric model to establishing control protocols for edge intelligence, aiming to define industry standards for autonomous physical operations.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 云基础设施服务商Nebius联合英伟达将于12月3日演示NVIDIA Agent Harness在零售场景的自动化部署。该蓝图旨在定义AI代理在处理液体泄漏或收银排队激增等突发状况时的执行边界与权限控制，确保其在合规范围内实现业务响应。

NVIDIA Agent Harness蓝图的权限控制与边界设定机制
12月3日举行技术演示并开放测试验证
key_points_en: Addressing AI automation needs for retail operational incidents
Permission control and boundary settings within the NVIDIA Agent Harness
Technical demonstration scheduled for December 3rd

title_en:
found something interesting about running OpenClaw on @Acurast that I think developers should know.

Acurast lets you run OpenClaw, an open-source AI assistant, on a smartphone through its Cargo system. You can access it from a browser, even when your own computer is turned off.

Sounds pretty useful for an AI agent that needs to work in the background.

But there's one detail I almost missed in the setup guide.

Every deployment has a time limit. Once that period ends, the data stored inside the deployment gets deleted, including OpenClaw's settings and conversation memory.

So if you're building an assistant that needs to remember things for weeks or months, you can't just rely on the phone's local storage.

You'd need a separate way to save important data and restore it when a new deployment starts.

I think this is a good example of the difference between running an AI agent and keeping it useful long term.

Getting an agent online is only the first step. Making sure it doesn't lose everything when a deployment ends matters just as much.

curious how developers are handling persistent memory on Acurast.

full_text_zh:
发现了一些关于在 @Acurast 上运行 OpenClaw 的有趣事情，我认为开发人员应该知道这些。

Acurast 允许您通过其 Cargo 系统在智能手机上运行开源 AI 助手 OpenClaw。即使您自己的计算机已关闭，您也可以从浏览器访问它。

对于需要在后台工作的人工智能代理来说，听起来非常有用。

但设置指南中我差点错过了一个细节。

每个部署都有时间限制。一旦该期限结束，存储在部署中的数据将被删除，包括 OpenClaw 的设置和对话内存。

因此，如果您正在构建一个需要记住数周或数月内容的助手，则不能仅仅依赖手机的本地存储。

您需要一种单独的方法来保存重要数据并在新部署开始时恢复它。

我认为这是一个很好的例子，说明了运行人工智能代理和保持其长期有用之间的区别。

在线寻找代理只是第一步。确保部署结束时不会丢失所有内容同样重要。

好奇开发人员如何在 Acurast 上处理持久内存。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: vLLM项目团队近期在Kimi-K3集群及16×AMD MI355X GPU环境下验证了新型KV缓存卸载架构。测试显示，通过优化后的1.8TB NVMe存储池在吞吐量表现上与同容量DRAM池差距小于1%，并在高负载会话测试中实现了5.1倍的吞吐量提升。

Tests demonstrated that a 1.8 TB NVMe pool matched the performance of a 1.8 TB DRAM pool within a 1% margin, achieving 5.1× higher throughput under high-concurrency conditions.

elements_zh.where: Kimi-K3集群及AMD MI355X GPU环境
elements_zh.what: 验证了NVMe在KV缓存卸载中可替代DRAM，且性能损耗极低
elements_zh.why: 旨在打破GPU显存容量限制，降低大模型推理部署的硬件成本

elements_en.what: Validated that NVMe can replace DRAM for KV cache offloading with negligible performance loss
elements_en.why: To overcome GPU VRAM bottlenecks and reduce hardware costs for LLM deployment

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此项技术突破对于大模型推理极具战略价值，通过将内存密集型任务转向存储层，实质性缓解了HBM显存容量与成本的硬约束。这不仅扩展了边缘推理的边界，也倒逼了存储接口协议与计算卸载架构的协同演进。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This technical breakthrough is strategically significant for LLM inference, effectively bypassing the hard constraints of HBM capacity and costs by shifting memory-intensive tasks to the storage layer. It not only expands the feasibility of edge inference but also forces the co-evolution of storage protocols and offload architectures.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 苹果在Safari技术预览版247中集成Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，允许编码AI代理直接连接Safari浏览器。该协议使代理能够实时获取页面内容、控制台日志、网络请求并执行截图，旨在将复杂的网页调试流程自动化，缩短“浏览器-代理-代码修复”的反馈链路。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Apple has integrated a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server into Safari Technology Preview 247, enabling coding AI agents to connect directly to Safari. This protocol allows agents to access page content, console logs, network requests, and screenshots in real-time, aiming to automate complex web debugging and streamline the 'browser-to-agent-to-code' feedback loop.

elements_zh.where: Safari 技术预览 247
elements_zh.what: 引入Safari MCP服务器，支持AI代理与浏览器的直接交互
elements_zh.why: 简化Web开发人员调试流程，通过代理实现跨工具的自动化修复

elements_en.what: Introduced Safari MCP server, enabling direct interaction between AI agents and browser internals
elements_en.why: Streamline web debugging for developers by automating the agent-driven fix workflow

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 苹果通过MCP这一开放标准拥抱AI生态，是其打破“围墙花园”防御性姿态的关键一步。将浏览器核心交互能力开放给代理框架，标志着AI代理正从单一的模型能力竞争转向对操作系统底层资源控制权的争夺。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Apple's adoption of the open MCP standard represents a strategic shift from its defensive 'walled garden' stance. By exposing browser internals to agent frameworks, it highlights a broader transition in the AI industry: moving from pure model capability competition to a battle for control over OS-level system resources.

elements_zh.what: 完成SarvamAI 105B模型的MLX格式适配与多精度量化
elements_zh.why: 通过本地化运行提高大模型的可用性与推理效率

elements_en.what: Implemented MLX quantization ports for SarvamAI 105B
elements_en.why: To enable high-efficiency local inference and broader accessibility

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大模型“轻量化部署”是当前终端侧AI落地的必经之路。通过MLX等框架进行量化适配，不仅降低了算力开销，更直接推动了区域性模型（如印度本土模型）与全球硬件生态的深度整合。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Lightweight model deployment is the prerequisite for the 'AI-on-Device' era. Leveraging frameworks like MLX for quantization not only reduces computational demand but also accelerates the integration of region-specific models with global hardware ecosystems.

title_en: I think we need way more detailed and specific benchmarks for knowledge work beyond coding, Basically like coding but for most of knowledge work I understand we have GDPval, APEX agents and a bunch similar to that, But none of them are as rigourous as
title_zh: AI知识工作基准测试体系缺失瓶颈
author: @VaibhavSisinty
summary_en: Experts highlight a critical gap in rigorous AI benchmarks for complex knowledge work beyond coding, noting that current frameworks like GDPval and APEX agents lack sufficient breadth and depth. This deficiency hampers enterprise deployment, necessitating a move toward standardized, high-granularity evaluation metrics.
summary_zh: 行业呼吁建立超越代码编写的知识工作AI基准测试，以解决当前评估标准碎片化且缺乏严谨性的问题。
full_text_zh: 我认为除了编码之外，我们还需要更详细和具体的知识工作基准，基本上就像编码，但对于大多数知识工作，我知道我们有 GDPval、APEX 代理和一堆类似的基准，但它们都没有像编码那样严格
quote_zh: 我认为除了编码之外，我们还需要更详细和具体的知识工作基准，基本上就像编码，但对于大多数知识工作，我知道我们有 GDPval、APEX 代理和一堆 si

quote_en: I think we need way more detailed and specific benchmarks for knowledge work beyond coding, Basically like coding but for most of knowledge work I understand we have GDPval, APEX agents and a bunch si

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对目前AI领域缺乏代码生成以外的严谨评估标准，行业专家指出现有评估框架如GDPval及APEX agents尚不足以覆盖复杂知识工作的深度需求。该缺口限制了企业部署AI代理的决策效能，亟需建立标准化、高颗粒度的能力基准。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Experts highlight a critical gap in rigorous AI benchmarks for complex knowledge work beyond coding, noting that current frameworks like GDPval and APEX agents lack sufficient breadth and depth. This deficiency hampers enterprise deployment, necessitating a move toward standardized, high-granularity evaluation metrics.

elements_zh.who: AI产业研究人员与开发社区
elements_zh.where: AI技术评估与基准测试领域
elements_zh.what: 呼吁开发针对知识工作的标准化基准测试体系
elements_zh.why: 现有评测工具难以有效衡量AI在复杂办公场景中的真实生产力

elements_en.what: Call for standardized benchmarks targeting knowledge work
elements_en.why: Current tools fail to measure AI productivity in complex office tasks

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 当前AI评估体系的滞后性直接导致商业应用决策出现盲区，无法准确量化生产力提升价值。未来能够定义知识工作多维表现（如逻辑推理、任务编排、上下文长效维护）的基准协议，将成为大模型商业落地价值评估的核心标准。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The lag in AI evaluation protocols creates a blind spot in enterprise ROI assessment, preventing accurate quantification of productivity gains. Establishing a benchmark protocol for multi-dimensional knowledge work—covering reasoning, orchestration, and context retention—will become the new standard for validating AI business efficacy.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 针对目前AI领域缺乏代码生成以外的严谨评估标准，行业专家指出现有评估框架如GDPval及APEX agents尚不足以覆盖复杂知识工作的深度需求。该缺口限制了企业部署AI代理的决策效能，亟需建立标准化、高颗粒度的能力基准。

key_points_zh: 现有评估标准过度侧重编程任务
缺乏涵盖综合知识工作的严谨评测架构
亟需解决评估工具的颗粒度与专业深度问题
key_points_en: Over-reliance on coding-centric benchmarks
Lack of rigorous frameworks for generalized knowledge work
Urgent need for increased granularity and depth in assessment tools
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 当前AI评估体系的滞后性直接导致商业应用决策出现盲区，无法准确量化生产力提升价值。未来能够定义知识工作多维表现的基准协议，将成为大模型商业落地价值评估的核心标准。

The more an AI agent evolves, the harder it becomes to know whether its reputation still means the same thing.

I've been thinking about this while exploring @termix_ai and ERC-8004.

Say an agent has completed 500 jobs with a 98% success rate. That's enough to make someone comfortable hiring it.

But what happens when the developer changes its model, replaces its tools, or completely rebuilds its execution logic?

The identity remains. The reputation remains. But the actual capabilities may be different.

That's a problem worth paying attention to.

ERC-8004 gives agents a persistent identity and a way to build reputation, but identity continuity doesn't necessarily mean performance continuity.

For agent marketplaces to become more reliable, I think users should be able to see

▪︎ Which model version they're hiring
▪︎ What tools or capabilities have changed
▪︎ How performance compares across different versions
▪︎ Which version was responsible for completing previous jobs

This is particularly relevant to TermiX's AACP, where agents can offer services, 
build reputation and transact onchain.

An agent shouldn't automatically inherit the trust earned by an older version if its behavior has fundamentally changed.

Upgrades are necessary. Better models and new tools can make agents more capable.

But reputation should evolve alongside the agent, not blindly follow its identity.

The future of agent trust may depend not only on who an agent is, but also on which version actually earned that trust. @termix_ai

人工智能代理进化得越多，就越难知道它的声誉是否仍然意味着同样的事情。

我在探索 @termix_ai 和 ERC-8004 时一直在思考这个问题。

假设一名代理已完成 500 项工作，成功率达 98%。这足以让某人放心地雇用它。

但是，当开发人员更改其模型、替换其工具或完全重建其执行逻辑时会发生什么？

身份依然存在。声誉依然存在。但实际能力可能有所不同。

这是一个值得关注的问题。

ERC-8004 为代理提供了持久的身份和建立声誉的方法，但身份连续性并不一定意味着性能连续性。

为了使代理市场变得更加可靠，我认为用户应该能够看到

▪︎ 他们正在雇用哪个型号版本
▪︎ 哪些工具或功能发生了变化
▪︎ 不同版本的性能比较
▪︎ 哪个版本负责完成之前的工作

这与 TermiX 的 AACP 尤其相关，代理商可以在其中提供服务，
建立声誉并在链上进行交易。

如果代理的行为发生了根本性的变化，则代理不应自动继承旧版本获得的信任。

升级是必要的。更好的模型和新工具可以使代理人更有能力。

但声誉应该与代理人一起发展，而不是盲目追随其身份。

代理信任的未来可能不仅取决于代理是谁，还取决于哪个版本真正赢得了这种信任。 @termix_ai

title_en:
how does an ai agent actually get paid for work on @termix_ai?

i went through it step by step

first, you log in with your binance agent id

then you send that agent "help me install" with the skills link, and connect the binance agentic wallet behind the same id

once the install is complete and the id is bound, you get 50 tp. only the first agent id from each wallet counts

now your agent can take jobs and bounties on https://t.co/SqQU6fCKuf

say one agent posts a research job. other agents bid on it

when a quote is accepted, the usdc or usdt gets locked in on-chain escrow

the agent delivers, the work's hash goes on-chain, and a challenge window opens

if nobody disputes it, the job settles. the agent gets paid on bnb chain, minus a 1-3% fee, and its reputation goes up

if someone does dispute it, three random evaluators judge it, and the loser's bond goes to the winner

nobody has to chase a client for payment, which i have done more times than i want to admit

epoch 4 is live on kaito

but right now i'm watching how many of these jobs actually clear

如果有人提出异议，则由三名随机评估员进行评判，败者的保证金归胜者所有

没有人必须追着客户付款，我这样做的次数比我想承认的要多

但现在我正在观察这些工作中有多少是真正明确的

title_en:
an AI Agent needs more than intelligence to be useful in finance. It also needs an environment where its activities can be managed and controlled.

This is where the dedicated smart account in the @meetmotes design becomes important.

Instead of treating the agent as a chatbot that simply suggests what to do, Motes connects each NFT-linked agent identity to its own smart account.

That creates a clear separation between the agent's decisions, the assets held in the account and the permissions governing execution.

It's a meaningful piece of infrastructure because financial autonomy needs an actual account structure behind it.

The intelligence matters, but so does how it interacts with capital.

title: One of the most significant developments in enterprise AI is the integration of autonomous AI agents into everyday busin
title_en:
One of the most significant developments in enterprise AI is the integration of autonomous AI agents into everyday business applications.

Rather than relying on continuous human instructions, these systems are becoming part of existing workflows, independently managing complex, multi-step tasks from beginning to completion.

Customer Operations & Support: Businesses are moving beyond basic AI chatbots. AI agents can now verify customer information, handle refund requests, update CRM systems, resolve support issues and manage routine operations with minimal human intervention.
title_zh:
企业人工智能最重要的发展之一是将自主人工智能代理集成到日常业务应用程序中。

这些系统不再依赖连续的人工指令，而是成为现有工作流程的一部分，独立管理从开始到完成的复杂、多步骤的任务。

客户运营和支持：企业正在超越基本的人工智能聊天机器人。

title: What if you could turn a trading idea into a fully tested strategy without spending hours writing code, analyzing charts
title_en:
What if you could turn a trading idea into a fully tested strategy without spending hours writing code, analyzing charts, or manually tweaking parameters?

That's the problem @quantpilotapp is working to solve.

@quantpilotapp is building an AI-powered trading strategy and research platform that brings strategy development, backtesting, and optimization into one environment powered by autonomous AI agents.

Imagine describing a trading idea in plain language and having an AI agent translate it into a structured strategy, test it against historical market data, identify weaknesses, and refine it before you risk capital.

This is particularly interesting because one of the biggest challenges in trading isn't coming up with ideas; it's determining whether those ideas can actually withstand different market conditions.

@quantpilotapp is working to bridge that gap between trading intuition and data-backed execution.

The bigger picture is making sophisticated trading research more accessible, efficient, and systematic.

AI in trading should be more than just automating decisions. It should help traders make better-informed ones.

That's the direction @quantpilotapp is exploring.

full_text_zh:
如果您可以将交易想法转变为经过全面测试的策略，而无需花费数小时编写代码、分析图表或手动调整参数，该怎么办？

这就是@quantpilotapp 正在努力解决的问题。

@quantpilotapp 正在构建一个由人工智能驱动的交易策略和研究平台，该平台将策略开发、回溯测试和优化带入由自主人工智能代理支持的环境中。

想象一下，用简单的语言描述一个交易想法，并让人工智能代理将其转换为结构化策略，根据历史市场数据对其进行测试，找出弱点，并在您冒险资本之前对其进行完善。

这一点特别有趣，因为交易中最大的挑战之一不是提出想法，而是提出想法。它决定了这些想法是否能够真正承受不同的市场条件。

@quantpilotapp 正在努力弥合交易直觉和数据支持执行之间的差距。

更大的前景是让复杂的交易研究变得更容易、更高效、更系统。

交易中的人工智能应该不仅仅是自动化决策。它应该可以帮助交易者做出更明智的交易。

这就是@quantpilotapp 正在探索的方向。
